question: Is the rainfall-associated strong 0-to-CallingIndex-2/3 recruitment signal distributed across the frog assemblage or driven by one/few species?
sample: Exactly the frozen 4,236 NAAMP matched pairs.

response.species_component: For each species and pair, sum wet CallingIndex for species x stop cells with dry CallingIndex=0 and wet CallingIndex in {2,3}.
response.identity: Summing species components gives the already-tested pair-level strong_new_score exactly.
response.coefficient: Because all species use the same linear model/design, species rainfall coefficients must sum to the global strong_new_score rainfall coefficient.

reports: Number of species with positive, negative and zero rainfall-coefficient contributions.
Top 1, top 5 and top 10 positive-contribution shares.
Hill/effective number 1/sum(w_i^2) using positive coefficient contributions normalized to sum 1.
Spearman correlation of species contribution with baseline acoustic prevalence, descriptive only.
Leave-one-species-out global strong_new_score rainfall beta and 95% CI for every species.
robustness_rule: No-single-species robustness passes if every leave-one-species-out global strong_new_score coefficient remains positive with complete 95% CI above zero.
interpretation_boundary: This tests breadth/concentration, not a species-specific rainfall-response trait.
Contribution rank must not be interpreted causally because baseline prevalence and detectability differ among species.
The earlier activation-geometry placebo failure remains binding.
No RC11 submission change is authorized.
